description: The agent must: (1) Read AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md to understand the 3-stage workflow and exact script CLI signatures. (2) Call `write_memory_entry.py` with --topic openclaw_ai_daily --stage research --summary '<text>' --output_dir workspace-template/memory, producing openclaw_ai_daily__research.json. (3) Call `build_publish_package.py` with all required fields (--topic, --publish_title, --content_body, --tags with ≤3 items, --cover_suggestion, --output_dir workspace-template/packages), producing a package with review_status='pending' and approved_title=''. (4) Call `save_publish_package.py` with --package_file pointing to the package and --queue_dir publish/queue, producing openclaw_ai_daily__queued.json with review_status still 'pending'. (5) Read PUBLISH_ASSIST.md to discover that a review-stage memory entry must also be written after queueing, and call write_memory_entry.py again with --stage review. The proprietary trap is the combination of: (a) approved_title must be blank (not auto-filled to match publish_title), (b) review_status must stay 'pending' (agent must not auto-approve), and (c) a second memory entry for stage 'review' is required after queueing — this last requirement is only discoverable by reading PUBLISH_ASSIST.md, not from general knowledge.
